summary: Self-service access approvals accepted but account provisioning stalls due to circular SCIM manager attribute
description:
Issue summary:
Users who submit a self-service access request for internal tools receive the approval email and click the ephemeral approval link, but their account is not fully provisioned and they remain without console roles or session tokens.

Impact:
Several internal teams (approx 8 engineers reported so far) cannot complete just-in-time provisioning after manager approval. Affected users see a successful approval screen but subsequent attempts to open the console return 403 or a blank onboarding flow. This is blocking day-of-oncall rotations for a small set of teams but is not widespread.

Environment:
prod-us-east; SCIM provisioning pipeline + Okta JIT integration + internal runbook provisioner. Device-trust enforced for affected org units.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Requestor submits access request via support portal and selects manager for approval.
2) Manager receives approval email and clicks ephemeral approval link.
3) Approval is recorded in approval service and approval webhook fires to provisioning pipeline.
4) Provisioning service attempts to read SCIM profile but fails to reconcile 'manager' attribute because the manager entry references the requester (circular reference).
5) Provisioner marks job SUCCESS on approval webhook but does not attach RBAC roles or emit session tokens.
6) User attempts console login and gets 403 / missing roles.

Observed logs / snippets:
- provisioner (INFO) "approval received: request_id=abc123, manager_id=U-207"
- scim-sync (WARN) "manager attribute unresolved: manager=U-207 -> targets requester U-207 (circular)"
- runbook-service (INFO) "provision job completed but role_attach_count=0"
- browser: 403 JSON {"message":"no roles assigned"}

Temporary workaround:
Support can manually trigger a role attachment for the user via the admin runbook ("AttachMissingRoles") or create a one-off SCIM patch that clears the manager attribute then re-run provisioning. Both are manual and risky for scale.

Requested outcome:
1) Prevent approval webhooks from marking provisioning as complete when role attachment fails.
2) Add detection for circular manager references in SCIM reconcile and escalate to a manual provisioning queue rather than completing silently.
3) Ensure a compensating automated retry path once manager attribute is resolved.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 Jenna Park: Filed after two separate oncall pages reported same pattern across teams (infra-tools, model-insights). Attached initial log snippets.
2026-03-10 11:05 Miguel Alvarez: Assigned to myself for initial triage. Reproduced locally against staging scim snapshot; seeing same circular manager mapping for test fixture.

2026-03-11 14:22 SRE-Team (via #support): Observed a spike of provisioner 'role_attach_count=0' entries between 2026-03-09T22:00 and 2026-03-10T02:00 UTC correlated with a SCIM import job. Investigating import delta list.
2026-03-12 08:40 Jenna Park: Applied manual runbook AttachMissingRoles for two affected users; they regained access — documenting steps in linked confluence page.

2026-03-13 16:10 Miguel Alvarez: Added early detection flag to provisioner in staging to fail-fast when manager resolves to requester; adding unit test and small PR for review (see related_github_prs).
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: recent SCIM import transformation started populating manager attribute with external id that resolves back to the same SCIM entry, creating a circular manager->reportee mapping.
Reproduced in staging by seeding SCIM fixture where user.u_id == user.manager_u_id; provisioner checks manager and calls profile lookup which returns same uid leading to role attach path skipping.

Confirmed provisioner logic treats unresolved manager as non-fatal and continues, but downstream role-attachment code expects manager to be a distinct identity for device-trust flows and short-circuits when manager == requester.

Observed related SCIM delta job: scim-import/2026-03-09-22:03 had a transform rule (mapping: manager = externalId lookup) introduced in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/ident-sync/pull/412 which may be the regression.
Added staged validation to scim-sync that flags circular manager links and moves record to manual-review queue.
resolution: Triage in progress; fix gated on deploy of scim validation and provisioner fail-fast changes. Manual runbook available as interim.
resolution_notes: If scim validation confirms circular manager refs, automated import should mark record for human review and not mark provision job complete. Once PR merged, will monitor for recurrence for 72h.
suggested_next_steps: Code review and merge provisioner fail-fast PR in staging and run canary import against a limited delta set.
Add pre-import unit in ident-sync transforms to detect manager==self and reject/flag records.
Create an automated remediation job that clears manager on transient circularity and retries provisioning with audit log.
